notes.title: Release Livestream and Q&A of Spellbound Spire (Tuesday June 23 - 8PM CEST)!
notes.content:
After 28 weeks of development, we're ready to release our non-euclidean VR game Spellbound Spire! 

Spellbound Spire is a non-euclidean VR traversal game with lots of puzzle elements. The game is about an hour-long experience where the player moves through a corrupted tower in order to restore the peace by capturing the corruption. The player will solve puzzles and learn new mechanics throughout the game, such as the gravity glove, which is used to make objects float in zero gravity. What makes the game unique is that the player solves these puzzles while navigating through a non-euclidean tower.

Option 44 is a 3rd-year student team studying International Game Architecture & Design Programme at the Breda University Of Applied Sciences.


Want to see more of our game, ask questions about the development and meet the people behind Spellbound Spire? Join our Livestream Tuesday, June 23 at 8 PM CEST!

notes.title: Spellbound Spire - Beta Version 1.3 Released
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes version Beta 1.3[/h1]

Hey everyone,
Thank you to everyone playing Spellbound spire during our beta, especially those taking the time to report any issues they encounter via our discord or form.

We added quite a few changes and updates to the game. We are listening closely to your feedback, and have identified and resolved a number of issues. The beta version 1.3 is now live! 

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Performance improvements 
[*] Pose for snail changed, you can now look at its face
[*] Added fade to black when going through a wall
[*] Objects can hover towards hand when on ground
[*] Updated Credits
[*] More Transition pieces
[*] Acquire gravity powers later in the game
[/list]
[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated sound mixing
[*] Updated sound effects
[*] Updated atmospheric set dressing
[/list]
[h2]Graphics & UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved font
[*] Improved Lighting across all levels 
[*] Updated various textures & materials
[*] Set-dressed levels
[*] Added ending VFX
[*] Added Wind and Sand VFX Effects inside levels
[*] Updated existing VFX effects
[*] New Skybox
[*] Added various decals
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Prevent players from playing the game in non-VR mode
[*] Fixed ghost pots
[*] Fixed height issue Oculus Rift S 
[*] Fixed teleportation issues hand and objects
[*] Fixed visual issues object clones
[*] Fixed teleporting out of the level
[*] Fixed some cheating/ sequence breaking
[*] Fixed portal flickering
[*] Fixed Corruption grids not destroying objects held in hand
[*] Fixed Doors opening multiple times
[/list]
[h2]Ongoing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Safety and security fixes
[*] Improved Oculus Rift support
[/list]
[h3]And more...[/h3]
